facts.fact: Morocco's justice minister says litigants can use online services such as tracking execution requests and obtaining copies of judgments, and lawyers can file online.
Morocco's justice minister says electronic payment of court fees, by bank card or other channels, is already in effect.
Morocco's justice minister says an electronic judicial case file, to digitise all case files of every type and jurisdiction, is being prepared.
Morocco's justice minister says lawyers can now file requests, briefs and appeal acts through a dedicated platform.
